terbaru.judul: Sequential Detection of Market shocks using Risk-averse Agent Based Models
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper considers a statistical signal processing problem involving agent based models of financial markets which at a micro-level are driven by socially aware and risk- averse trading agents.

terbaru.judul: Wealth distribution across communities of adaptive financial agents
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper studies the trading volumes and wealth distribution of a novel agent-based model of an artificial financial market.

terbaru.judul: Understanding Financial Market States Using Artificial Double Auction Market
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we propose an artificial double auction market as an agent-based model approach to study the origin of complex states in the financial markets, characterizing important parameters with an investment strategy that can cover the dynamics of the financial market.

terbaru.judul: Universality of Tsallis q-exponential of interoccurrence times within the microscopic model of cunning agents
terbaru.pelajaran: The predictions of our model, found by simulations, well agree with the empirical universal distribution of interoccurrence times between daily losses below negative thresholds following the Tsallis q-exponential.

terbaru.judul: Herding interactions as an opportunity to prevent extreme events in financial markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that introduction of agents with predefined fundamentalist trading behavior helps to significantly reduce the probability of the extreme price fluctuations events.

terbaru.judul: Analysis of a decision model in the context of equilibrium pricing and order book pricing
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a simple decision model and consider its implications in two different pricing schemes.

terbaru.judul: On the acceleration of spatially distributed agent-based computations: a patch dynamics scheme
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we construct a finite-volume-inspired conservative patch dynamics scheme and apply it to a financial market agent-based model based on the work of Omurtag and Sirovich [22].

terbaru.judul: Physics and Financial Economics (1776-2014): Puzzles, Ising and Agent-Based models
terbaru.pelajaran: This short review presents a selected history of the mutual fertilization between physics and economics, from Isaac Newton and Adam Smith to the present.

terbaru.judul: Collective behaviours in the stock market -- A maximum entropy approach
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we used a statistical inverse approach to model the structure and co-movements in financial markets.

terbaru.judul: Consentaneous agent-based and stochastic model of the financial markets
terbaru.pelajaran: As a result we propose a three state agent-based herding model of the financial markets.
